global: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth fills a white bowl, topped with shredded bean sprouts and fresh greens. The rich, reddish-orange broth glistens under bright light, set against a dark tray with a price tag visible.

regions.background: Dark brown tray with glossy finish, smooth surface, slightly curved edges, and visible label corner.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with subtle speckled pattern, smooth glossy surface, and slightly raised rim with faint printed text.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is reddish-orange, glossy, and contains visible noodles, bean sprouts, and green herbs floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with glistening, slightly fatty surface and visible marbling.
